jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (SQL, Power BI)
jobs.description:
Data Analyst


We are looking for a  Data Analyst  with strong SQL, dashboarding, and business analysis skills to transform business questions into clear, actionable analytical outputs.


The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across business and technical teams, translating requirements into structured analysis, building dashboards and reports, and maintaining clear documentation around business metrics, definitions, and data logic.


Analyze data using  SQL  to identify trends, opportunities, anomalies, and business issues.


Translate business needs into structured analysis plans and measurable outputs.


Create and maintain  semantic definitions, metric logic, business glossary content, and knowledge documentation  .


Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies across systems, dashboards, and reporting layers.


Partner with  Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams  to improve reporting clarity and data understanding.


3+ years of experience  in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.


Strong  SQL  skills with experience working with large datasets.Hands-on experience building dashboards using  Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI platforms  .Experience documenting requirements using  JIRA, user stories, acceptance criteria, or similar methodologies  .Ability to quickly understand business context, data structures, and analytical requirements.Ability to produce  clear, actionable analysis with minimal ramp-up time  .Experience with  semantic layers, KPI frameworks, or data modeling concepts  .Familiarity with  Agile/Scrum delivery environments  .


Experience collaborating with both  technical and non-technical stakeholders  .


Experience working with business glossaries, data catalogs, or knowledge management practices.


The ideal candidate is a  business-oriented Data Analyst  who can work independently, ask the right questions, and turn complex data into insights that stakeholders can understand and act upon. Strong communication, documentation, and analytical thinking are just as important as technical SQL and BI skills.

Job description
About Keka:


Keka is India's #1 People Operations Platform, trusted by 8,500+ businesses to manage their HR, payroll, attendance, and performance processes. We are on a mission to make HR delightful and we're looking for passionate people to help us scale that mission through world-class marketing.

jobs.title: SAP Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled SAP Data Analyst to join our team in Karnataka, Maharashtra, or Andhra Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP technologies, particularly SAP Datasphere and SAP BW, along with expertise in data governance and SQL. As an SAP Data Analyst, you will play a crucial role in managing and analyzing data to support business decisions and ensure data integrity across various platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and analyze data requirements.
- Design and implement data governance frameworks to ensure compliance and data quality.
- Utilize SAP Datasphere and SAP BW for data modeling, reporting, and analytics.
- Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
- Monitor data processes and troubleshoot issues to maintain data accuracy and reliability.
- Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis to drive business improvements.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in SAP Datasphere and SAP BW.
- Strong understanding of data governance principles and practices.
- Experience with SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
- Familiarity with SAP HANA is a plus.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders.

If you are passionate about data and have the required skills, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to our data-driven initiatives.
